title: Scene: 60-second tour
description: Meet the Tools palette, the Brush, and the map canvas.

steps.hint: The Tools palette lives here. Pick a tool — paint, erase, fill — to drive your strokes.
The Brush panel sets the shape and size of your stroke. Click Next when you're ready.
And here's your map canvas — click and drag to paint tiles. That's the scene workflow in a nutshell!
